review_comments:
Signal strength sensors are usually disabled by default
```suggestion
        entity_registry_enabled_default=False,
        entity_category=EntityCategory.DIAGNOSTIC,
    ),
```

I think your suggestion is on the wrong line. Is the way it is now correct? Adding:
```
entity_registry_enabled_default=False,
entity_category=EntityCategory.DIAGNOSTIC,
```
To the signal strength sensor entity description?

As discussed, you can now work on splitting out the unique_id and the name.

One way is to add a `Mixin` class to the `EntityDescription` with a compulsory `unique_id` attribute, and then use `f"{econet_device.device_id}_{econet_device.device_name}_{description.unique_id}"`

The other way is to implement a migration with `async_migrate_entries`.
